newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CST, according to analysts.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Active fed cattle trade and choice beef prices continue sharp advance.
FEEDER CATTLE - Up 0.200 to 0.300 cent. CME index up to highest level in nearly 11 months.
HOGS - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Steady to higher live calls on lighter than expected marketings. Pork cutout up.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.300 to up 0.300 cent. Out-of-town called bearish but hog kills light and cash firm.
